title: AITab Catalog
description: A2UI-compatible custom component catalog for Firefox AITab pages. Adopts the A2UI 1.0 *component/UI model* — a surface is a FLAT list of components (an adjacency list) where each component is `{ "id", "component": <TypeName>, ...props }`, exactly one has id `root`, parent/child links are id references (never inlined), and all displayed data lives in a separate JSON `dataModel` addressed by JSON-Pointer bindings.  Bindable properties accept a literal value OR a `{ "path": "/..." }` binding. Repeating regions or non boilerplate information should in bound data in the dataModel section. `components` maps each AITab component name to its property schema. Anything clickable simply carries an `href` (a URL or in-app route).

ComponentId.description: The `id` of another component in the same surface. Relationships are expressed by id reference, never by inlining the child object.

path.description: JSON-Pointer (RFC 6901) into the surface data model. An absolute path starts with `/` and resolves from the data-model root; a bare path (no leading `/`) is relative to the enclosing template/repeater scope.

DynamicString.description: A literal string, or a binding to a string in the data model. Prefer a binding when the value is real content pulled from the user's tabs/history.

DynamicArray.description: A literal array, or a binding to an array in the data model. Prefer a binding so presentation (this component) stays separate from data (the model). Item shapes for each component are described on the owning property.

ChildList.description: Children referenced by id: either a fixed array of component ids, or a template repeater `{ componentId, path }` that instantiates the template component once per element of the bound array. Children are never defined inline.

path.description: Absolute JSON-Pointer to the array to repeat over.

Field.description: A column definition for RankedTable. Describes how a value in each row object is labeled, formatted, and placed. This is presentation config (literal), not data.

key.description: Property name read from each row object in the bound `rows` array.

role.description: Where the value renders in a row: title/subtitle=primary cell; detail=a column.

prefix.description: What to put before every value (i.e. `$`)

suffix.description: What to put after every value (i.e. ` / day`)

goal.description: Which direction is better; drives per-row best-value highlighting and superlatives.

SourceLinks.description: A set of source links. Referenced inline by Header.references and Highlights.sources, and reused by the SourceLinks block component.

items.description: The source links (a literal array, or a binding to an array in the data model).

ListGroup.description: A group of list items; omit `heading` for an ungrouped list.

Page.description: Root container for an AITab page. Use as the single component whose id is `root`. Holds a Header and an ordered list of body-block component ids, all by id reference.

children.description: Ordered ids of the body block components.

Header.description: Single block that opens every page and frames what it's about.

eyebrow.description: Automatically filled in with run date (leave blank)

subhead.description: One sentence to add context beyond title. No repetition.

references.description: Links to all pages used for this report.

TextBlock.description: Plain prose: a larger lead sentence followed by body paragraphs.

paragraphs.description: Body paragraphs (a literal array of strings, or a binding to one).

RankedTable.description: Record-oriented comparison table: many items, a few attributes each. Use for ranking/listing options where each row is one entity. Columns are defined here; the rows come from the data model.

rows.description: Row data. Item shape: an object keyed by the column `key`s, plus an optional `href`: the URL of the page the item came from, shown as a source chip. Bind to an array in the data model.

SourceLinks.description: Small auto-expandable list of source links. Use to let the reader get to a link; condenses/expands for any count. Use a short title if available.

List.description: Optionally grouped list items. Use for informational lists or things a user needs to do. If ungrouped leave heading field off.

layout.description: Use 'column' for short phrases and 'row' when the individual list items are typically one or more sentences

groups.description: Groups of list items; omit `heading` for an ungrouped list. A literal array, or a binding to one.

Timeline.description: Anything with times or dates attached.

items.description: Timeline entries in order (a literal array, or a binding to one).

Highlights.description: One or more evidence-backed statements that are related topically or parallel in construction. Place it after the main body content, never as the first body block. Use TextBlock instead for unrelated bullet points, or when nothing stands out enough to highlight. Each statement can attach the sources behind it via its own `sources`.

title.description: Optional heading for the group of statements.

items.description: The statements (a literal array of HighlightItem, or a binding to one).
